items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out. Sell it for Ricochet.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Feed The Birds unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Radiant Regeneration. Ultimate (Feed The Birds) is available from Radiant Regeneration.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Threadsap (1 to 2).

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Radiant Regeneration completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Radiant Regeneration completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Burst Fire, 12000 souls (~12.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Radiant Regeneration completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Radiant Regeneration completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Regeneration (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Burst Fire, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-24,800 (levels 15-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Threadsap T3, Granny Long Legs T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Baba's Brew, combat barrier) grows from 127 to 163. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Fortitude, weapon 4.8k at Burst Fire.

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Burst Fire
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Threadsap (3 to 4). Takes spirit from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 16 to Feed The Birds's barrage max damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Granny Long Legs: takes 18% off its 25s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,800-48,000 (levels 28-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Baba's Brew T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Baba's Brew, combat barrier) grows from 163 to 244.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 46 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 149s; 20% off is 29.8s per full rotation.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 28.8 to Feed The Birds's barrage max damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 15,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 48 to Feed The Birds's barrage max damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,800 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Burst Fire? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Fortitude.
sections.desc: Dying after Burst Fire? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Fortitude.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Two or more gun heroes keep hitting you.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming, like Bebop's hook or Apollo's ult.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows keep you off them.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hitting you.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Their healer keeps your target alive. Sell Reactive Barrier for this.

items.name: Indomitable
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Reactive Barrier for 4,800 more souls: cooldown reduction on proc 0 to 20; bullet resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
